name: second-read
description: A reader-first editing skill that proposes source-anchored improvements and assembles the version you approve.

interface.longDescription: Edit a draft before publishing it. Second Read follows the document in the order a real reader encounters it, proposes small source-anchored edits, asks targeted questions where meaning could diverge, and assembles the revision you approve. It preserves your voice and invents no facts.
defaultPrompt: Give this a second read before I publish it.
Edit this for a first-time reader while keeping my voice.
Check this draft for unsupported claims and confusing passages.
